test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: X is directly proportional to A² and A is inversely proportional to Y. If X is 97 when Y is 6, find X when Y is 2.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given: **X ∝ A²** and **A ∝ 1/Y**.

Combining these, **X ∝ (1/Y)²** ⇒ **X ∝ 1/Y²**.

Relationship: **X₁ × Y₁² = X₂ × Y₂²**.

97 × 6² = X₂ × 2² ⇒ 97 × 36 = X₂ × 4.

X₂ = 97 × 9 = 873.

**∴ The correct answer is 873.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe43db152a68c34a3000a70f93f9aff48ccad32c4bb4ba35850d6243098157a0.png] 

**Given:** X₁ = 97, Y₁ = 6, Y₂ = 2.

**Formula Used:** X = k/Y² or X₁Y₁² = X₂Y₂²

⇒ X ∝ A² and A ∝ 1/Y ⇒ A² ∝ 1/Y²

⇒ Therefore, X ∝ 1/Y²

⇒ 97 = k / 6²

⇒ k = 97 × 36

⇒ X₂ = k / 2²

⇒ X₂ = (97 × 36) ÷ 4

⇒ X₂ = 97 × 9 = 873

**∴ The correct answer is 873.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Direct Proportionality

If **y ∝ x**, then **y = kx**. The ratio **y/x** remains constant for all pairs of variables.

Inverse Proportionality

If **y ∝ 1/x**, then **xy = k**. The product of the two variables remains constant.

Joint Variation

When a variable depends on two or more other variables, such as **z ∝ xy**, leading to **z = kxy**.</p
